author: Medicines Optimisation / Clinical Genomics joint rule set
source: CPIC fluoropyrimidine/DPYD guideline; NHS England DPYD testing mandate (2020)

poor_metaboliser.summary: DPYD poor metaboliser (DPD deficiency): fluoropyrimidine is contraindicated at standard dose. Do not issue. Oncology must select an alternative agent or, if no alternative exists, use a strongly reduced dose with therapeutic drug monitoring.

intermediate_metaboliser.summary: DPYD intermediate metaboliser (partial DPD deficiency): reduce starting dose by 50% and titrate on toxicity and drug-level monitoring.

normal_metaboliser.summary: DPYD normal metaboliser: standard fluoropyrimidine dosing.
